Contributions to Liberation War: Bangladesh honours 10 Indian naval war veterans
2021-10-06T14:47:32+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/diplomacy/news/contributions-liberation-war-bangladesh-honours-10-indian-naval-war-veterans-2191981

As part of the birth centenary celebrations of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, High Commissioner of Bangladesh to India, Muhammad Imran, has honoured 10 Indian naval war veterans from across the country -- acknowledging their contribution during the Liberation War of Bangladesh in 1971.

The high commissioner honoured the Indian war veterans at a function hosted on board the Bangladesh Navy ship "Somudra Avijan" at Visakhapatnam yesterday, reports our New Delhi correspondent.

India's Rear Admiral Tarun Sobti, Flag Officer Commanding the country's Eastern Naval Fleet, was the chief guest at the event which was attended by Rear Admiral Jyotin Raina and other senior officers of the eastern naval command.
